subject: Quick quote + publish permission for LightLane renewal
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@lightlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick quote + publish permission for LightLane renewal

Hi Alyssa —

We really appreciate LightLane’s partnership over the past 18 months. As we prepare the renewal conversation and the expansion proposal, Marketing asked if you could provide:

- A one-sentence quote (1–2 lines) about the business value Redwood has unlocked for LightLane that we can use in a one-pager and on our site.
- A quick confirmation of which outcome metrics we may publish (we currently have: ~35% inference cost reduction, ~2x throughput during nightly ETL workloads). If there are items you want redacted, tell us which ones.

I attached a tiny quote template to make it easy. If it helps, we can draft options and you can pick/edit. We’re aiming to include this in the renewal packet we share with your execs next week.

Thanks so much — really appreciate you taking a minute for this.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
[Attachment: quote_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@lightlane.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bowers <tom.bowers@lightlane.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick quote + publish permission for LightLane renewal

Neha —

Happy to help. Here’s a short quote you can use:

"Redwood’s inference platform cut our production latency and cost meaningfully — allowing us to deliver richer features to customers while reducing nightly processing spend. The team was straightforward to work with and responsive during our scale-up."

You may publish the following outcome metrics: 35% reduction in inference cost; 2x throughput on peak nightly jobs. Please do not publish internal revenue impact numbers or any details about our exact cluster sizes.

Attribution: Alyssa Chen, VP Product, LightLane Analytics.

Thanks — and let me know if you want a slightly shorter or punchier version for the website.

Best,
Alyssa Chen
VP Product | LightLane Analytics
alyssa@lightlane.com | +1 (917) 555-2210

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@lightlane.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick quote + publish permission for LightLane renewal

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 10:05 AM Alyssa Chen <alyssa@lightlane.com> wrote:
> Neha —
> 
> Happy to help. Here’s a short quote you can use:
> 
> "Redwood’s inference platform cut our production latency and cost meaningfully — allowing us to deliver richer features to customers while reducing nightly processing spend. The team was straightforward to work with and responsive during our scale-up."
> 
> You may publish the following outcome metrics: 35% reduction in inference cost; 2x throughput on peak nightly jobs. Please do not publish internal revenue impact numbers or any details about our exact cluster sizes.
> 
> Attribution: Alyssa Chen, VP Product, LightLane Analytics.

Alyssa — really appreciate this. We’ll slot the quote into the renewal one-pager and the customer success play. Monica — I’m attaching the one-pager draft we plan to share with LightLane execs; we’ll leave revenue numbers redacted per Alyssa’s note.

Could you confirm the preferred web attribution formatting? Alyssa suggested title + company which is fine, but Marketing often asks whether to include a headshot or not. If we need a headshot, we’ll request it separately.

[Attachment: LL-one-pager-for-website.pdf (application/pdf), draft_v1-case-excerpt.txt]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@lightlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick quote + publish permission for LightLane renewal

Alyssa — perfect, thank you.

We’ll use the quote exactly as written and publish the two outcome metrics you approved. We will not include revenue or cluster-size details. Attribution will read: "Alyssa Chen, VP Product, LightLane Analytics" on the site and in the renewal one-pager.

Ben/Monica — next steps: finalize the one-pager PDF and the HubSpot renewal packet. I’ve linked the HubSpot record and the draft case one-pager here for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/LightLane-4821 and https://drive.redwood.com/shared/LL-case-one-pager.

Alyssa — if Marketing wants a headshot, we’ll send a single-line request; otherwise we’ll proceed with text-only attribution. We’ll also share final proofs before publishing. Thanks again — huge help for the renewal narrative.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
